zh_CN: 醒了？这镇子就剩我一个打铁的了。
en: Awake? I'm the last smith left in this town.

zh_CN: 你手上空着 —— 拿这把。铁坯是我亲手打的。
en: Your hands are empty. Take this — I forged the billet myself.

zh_CN: 镇子右边那道门，过去就是后山。先去练练手。
en: The gate on the right leads to the back hills. Go get some practice.

zh_CN: 打回来的碎片别扔，炉子在这儿，我给你锤。
en: Don't toss the shards you bring back. The forge is here — I'll hammer them for you.

zh_CN: 回来了？身上那件，比先前像样了。
en: Back already? That thing on you looks better than before.

zh_CN: 炉子还热着，碎片够了就来。
en: The forge is still hot. Come when you have enough shards.

zh_CN: 别往前 —— 那东西在磨刀。
en: Don't go further — that thing is sharpening its blade.

zh_CN: 它那一锤下来，地都要裂。
en: One smash from it splits the ground.

zh_CN: 退两步，等它收招，再贴上去砍。
en: Step back, wait for it to recover, then close in.

封锁中 —— 先打倒这里的守卫
到顶了。后面这条路上还有活的东西，但都不成气候了。
en: We're at the top. A few things still stir below, but nothing serious.

zh_CN: 你在镇上攒的那些，够你往更远的地方走了。
en: What you've gathered in town is enough to carry you further.
